limitations: Toast was tested through its component API with auto-dismiss disabled (data-duration=0), not a user click path.
Tooltip focus was initiated with DOM focus(); Escape was sent through Marionette actions.
The suite is targeted component acceptance, not a complete cross-browser or visual-regression matrix.
The copied fixture is a page harness; the original profile, raw protocol log, absolute temp paths, and 44 KB runner were not copied.
